GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol are now available. Super efficient and built to perform where it counts—the real world.

GPT-6.2 Astra—a frontier model built for your hardest projects. It sets new highs on evals across professional work and scientific research at less than a third of the cost per task of GPT‑6 Astra.

GPT-6.2 Sol—an efficient and versatile model for everyday work. It powers through multistep agentic workflows, writes clearly and naturally, and is intuitive to collaborate with. 

Starting today, GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol are available in ChatGPT Work and Codex for Plus, Pro, Enterprise, and Edu users. 

Pro 500 subscribers can use Ultrafast with either model. For the first time, we’re also bringing Ultrafast to Pro 200 subscribers, starting with GPT-6.2 Sol.

Developers can access gpt-6.2-astra and gpt-6.2-sol in the OpenAI API, with Ultrafast available.
